_comment: The pinned Projects UI artifact: url + sha256 + source commit. TODAY the artifact is built LOCALLY from an UNPUBLISHED commit of the UI source (source_commit_published=false) and lives in this repository (local_path), so builds and tests are offline and reproducible; no release of redevops-projects has been published for it, so `url` is empty and this record is NOT a source offer (decisions pins-04, pins-10 and D-LIC-12 stay OPEN; packaging/ui-bundle-source.json carries the same provenance). A later publication changes only `url` (the release asset URL) and, if the published commit differs, source_commit/sha256; scripts/fetch_projects_ui.py verifies the sha256 before anything is extracted, whichever source it reads. `previous_pin` is the public release v0.2.0 the main line fetched before (Today-first UI): NOT contained in this artifact, see the convergence report.

recipe.environment: env -i with PATH, throwaway HOME and TMPDIR, LANG and an isolated npm cache; VITE_PROJECTS_API=/ is the only build variable passed; built from a clean `git archive` of source_commit
recipe.pack: scripts/make_projects_ui_artifact.py DIST packaging/ui-artifacts/projects-ui-root-2fdef7f5.tgz (sorted members, mtime 2020-01-01Z, uid/gid 0, gzip mtime 0; the neutral hero.jpg of this repository replaces the UI repository's public/hero.jpg)
recipe.reproduced: index.html, the JavaScript and the CSS were built three times in clean environments (two earlier sessions, and the convergence trunk on 2026-11-06) with identical sha256; two consecutive packs give an identical archive. The archive bytes also depend on the zlib in use; the member hashes above are the portable invariant, the archive sha256 is what is pinned.

previous_pin.note: public release asset fetched by origin/main; Today-first UI (Today, capture, batch triage, notifications, routing, deployment-inspection and social-intelligence cards). The accessibility series (UIA-01..12) is NOT in it and the Today-first views are NOT in the current artifact.
